prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: preview-only visual direction sketch for a desktop web operations dashboard
Primary request: Create one deliberately unfinished, flat matte UI direction sketch for DUMA, a contemporary café operations system. This is a directional concept board, not a polished production screenshot, not photorealistic, and not an illustration of a physical room.
Canvas: landscape desktop frame, exactly 1536 × 1024 pixels, straight-on view, full interface visible with generous outer margin.
Structure: compact left navigation rail plus a broad operational workspace organized as one clear linear workflow of stations. The stations form an unmistakable start-to-finish sequence across the main area, connected through sober rules and directional structure rather than arrows as decoration. Show a current task station rendered bright and active, adjacent completed and upcoming stations visibly distinct through checks, line styles, fill patterns, and position. Include a substantial preview/test state before a final commit action: a split inspection area or proof pane that lets an operator review the result, compare it, and confirm only after checking. Keep the interface dense enough for café operations but calm and highly scannable.
UI treatment: dark charcoal application environment under restrained warm amber safelight coloration; matte surfaces; enamel-white input and preview fields; warm neutral labels; thin rules; small 6px corner radii; no shadows or glow. Compact operational controls, station headers, rows, check marks, outlined pending states, hatched test state, and a clear final action boundary. State meaning must never depend only on color.
Composition: DUMA in the upper-left navigation rail. “Run the shift clearly” is the single workspace headline. Everything else must be non-language greeked interface copy: indistinct horizontal bars and abstract placeholder lines, with no readable words, letters, numbers, prices, dates, or fake labels.
Style/medium: crisp 2D digital product-design sketch, flat matte vector-like rendering, intentionally one refinement pass short of polished, pragmatic café-operations energy. Think process proofing and careful station handoff, not a darkroom scene.
Color palette: use only #1D1B1A, #E5A43A, #F2E8D5, and #8D7770, plus opacity variants of those same colors. #1D1B1A is the primary environment; #E5A43A identifies current attention with restraint; #F2E8D5 forms enamel-white fields and primary legibility; #8D7770 carries warm neutral secondary structure.
Text (verbatim): “DUMA” and “Run the shift clearly”
Constraints: render those two phrases accurately and legibly, and no other legible text anywhere. Make the workflow and preview-before-commit logic understandable from composition, patterns, and controls. Keep corners at 6px, never pillowy.
Avoid: photography; people; café photography; literal darkroom equipment; film canisters; enlargers; chemical trays; red-room clichés; glow; neon; light bloom; hazard stripes or warning-tape aesthetics; industrial hazard symbols; glassmorphism; blur; gloss; generic bento-dashboard grids; oversized KPI cards; floating hero metrics; decorative AI symbols; sparkle icons; starbursts; robots; water or ocean imagery; gradients; 3D; excessive shadows; rounded pill cards; extra readable text; lorem ipsum.
